bagPolicy.summary: The venue permits bags and backpacks up to A4 size; concert promoters may impose tighter rules.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Car parks P04, P05 and P07 are listed for cars, with limited spaces near the venue; the venue recommends public transport.
